How much is Elon Musk worth, and who does the counting
Forbes and Bloomberg price Musk’s public stakes at the market, estimate the private ones, and subtract known debt. On September 6, 2026, their totals were $904 billion and $908 billion, according to Wikipedia’s summary of both indexes.
SpaceX is most of the number. The Forbes profile counts a 38% SpaceX stake including options and nearly 11% of Tesla, before unvested restricted stock that could add about 8% more.
Musk also owns pieces of Neuralink and The Boring Company. Both are private and publish no financials, so any dollar figure for them is an outside guess.
What made up Elon Musk’s net worth on Aug. 1, 2026
Bloomberg’s split of a $684 billion total, in billions of U.S. dollars
Source: Bloomberg Billionaires Index, as reported by Fortune on Aug. 1, 2026. Figures are estimates. “Other” covers Neuralink, The Boring Company and cash, which Bloomberg did not itemize. No newer dollar breakdown has been published.
Who is Elon Musk, and where the first money came from
Elon Musk made about $180 million when eBay bought PayPal in October 2002. PayPal had formed from a merger with X.com, the online bank Musk started in 1999, as PayPal’s ownership history shows.
That money went into SpaceX, founded in 2002, and Tesla, which Musk backed in 2004 and has run as CEO since 2008. Forbes first listed Musk as a billionaire in 2012, at $2 billion.
Tesla carried the next decade. Its market value went from $75.7 billion at the end of 2019 to $1.06 trillion two years later, per Tesla’s year-by-year market capitalization .
Elon Musk today runs SpaceX, which now includes xAI and X, and is still Tesla’s CEO.
Elon Musk net worth 2025 vs. 2026: the SpaceX swing
Private share sales did the work in 2025. Forbes had Musk at 500billioninOctoberand 677 billion on December 15, after a tender offer valued SpaceX at $800 billion.
In February 2026, SpaceX acquired xAI, which already owned the former Twitter. That deal pushed Forbes’ estimate past $800 billion; the earlier step is covered in how X ended up inside xAI .
SpaceX priced its IPO at $135 a share on June 11, valuing the company near $1.77 trillion, CNN reported . Shares reached $225.64 on June 16, and Bloomberg’s estimate peaked near $1.33 trillion.
The fall took about six weeks. By August 1, Bloomberg had Musk at $684 billion, and Forbes had the figure back at $892 bill

Elon Musk Net Worth in 2026 — How Rich Is He?
Elon Musk was worth $1.02 trillion at the October 7, 2026 close (Bloomberg Billionaires Index; Forbes's real-time count put him at $936 billion on October 1). He became the world's first trillionaire on June 12, 2026 , when SpaceX went public in the largest IPO in history—pricing at $135 per share, raising $86.25 billion including the underwriters' option (the sale closed on June 15, according to SpaceX's 10-Q), and reaching a valuation near $1.77 trillion (over $2 trillion after its first day of trading). Bloomberg had him at a peak of $1.32 trillion on June 16; he later fell back below $1 trillion, to $914 billion at the October 1 close, on lower SpaceX and Tesla share prices and Bloomberg's removal of about $111 billion of unvested Tesla shares from its count, before returning to $1.02 trillion at the October 7 close; a 3.6% fall in his shares on October 13 left him at $966.5 billion. His fortune is built primarily on his ownership stakes in SpaceX (~38%, now publicly traded as Nasdaq: SPCX, which absorbed xAI and X in February 2026), Tesla (~13% of shares + stock options), and the Boring Company.

Methodology
Where this number comes from
One source, fetched daily
We read Elon Musk's finalWorth from the Forbes Real-Time Billionaires
API once a day and rebuild the whole site from it. Nothing on this page is hand-typed or estimated by us.
Validated before it ships
Each fetch is retried and checked against a plausible range before it is accepted. A wild value from a
broken upstream response is rejected rather than published.
Stale data is labelled, not hidden
If every source fails we keep the last known figure and mark it stale instead of showing an invented
number, and that day is not written into the history table above.
